CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetLocale

Returns the name of the locale that the LS functions use for the current request. Unless a page has called SetLocale, this is "English (US)".

Category

International functions

Syntax

GetLocale()

Returns

A locale name such as "English (US)".

Usage

Gibson KoldFusion for UNIX ships with the English (US) locale tables only; see SetLocale for the details.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>The current locale is <B>#GetLocale()#</B>.</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Function</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>LSDateFormat(Now(), "long")</TD><TD>#LSDateFormat(Now(), "long")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>LSTimeFormat(Now())</TD><TD>#LSTimeFormat(Now())#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>LSCurrencyFormat(1999.99)</TD><TD>#LSCurrencyFormat(1999.99)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

SetLocale, LSDateFormat, LSCurrencyFormat, LSNumberFormat
